title: QUIC RFC 9000 Initial Stream Limit Transport Parameters Verification
verification_method: Focused S18P2 0010-0014 requirement-home tests, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, Release build, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers initial_max_streams_bidi and initial_max_streams_uni transport-parameter encoding and the managed runtime stream-open behavior for absent, zero, and advertised initial stream-count limits.
expected_result: The focused tests show that initial_max_streams_bidi and initial_max_streams_uni are encoded and parsed as their own variable-length integer transport parameters, accept the 2^60 boundary, reject values above that boundary, permit local stream opens up to the advertised initial limit, block stream opens when the corresponding value is absent or zero, and unblock only after a later MAX_STREAMS frame increases the matching stream-count limit.
procedure: Run the focused S18P2 0010-0014 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The transport-parameter codec accepts and emits RFC 9000 Section 18.2 transport-parameter tuples.
The stream-state bookkeeping exposes local stream-open decisions and STREAMS_BLOCKED frame details.
Existing MAX_STREAMS frame handling remains the mechanism for raising stream-count limits after the handshake.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim closure for initial data-limit parameters, max_ack_delay policy, disable_active_migration, preferred_address fields, public stream APIs, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The focused S18P2 0010-0014 requirement-home filter passed 13/13, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0010 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0014 trace_clean, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 427 artifacts, Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, and the full Release test suite passed 4422/4422.
